question: India participated in the Petersberg Climate Dialogue 2020 hosted virtually by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Germany.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The 11th session of the Petersberg Climate Dialogue with 30 countries **including India took place on **April 28, 2020,** through a video conference.
 
• The dialogue was conducted to discuss the ways of tackling the societies and economies after COVID-19.
 
• The Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Prakash Javedekar attended the Dialogue.
 
• The Dialogue was hosted by **Germany.**
 
• Germany:** Capital - Berlin**.
 
• Currency - **Euro.**
